card.line: Golgotha, meaning The Place of the Skull, was the well-known spot near Jerusalem where Jesus was crucified between two robbers.

moments.title: Carrying the cross to Golgotha
moments.text: Soldiers took Jesus away, and He went out carrying His own cross. They forced Simon of Cyrene to carry the cross of Jesus along the way, and they brought Him to Golgotha.

moments.title: Jesus is crucified
moments.text: At Golgotha they crucified Jesus with two robbers, one on each side. Pilate posted a sign over Him that called Him the King of the Jews, written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.

moments.title: Wine offered and garments divided
moments.text: They offered Jesus wine mixed with gall, but after tasting it He refused to drink. The soldiers divided His garments by casting lots and sat down to keep watch over Him.
